units.source_text: 源氏公子走到边门口的过廊里，在那里站着。

en.t: Prince Genji walked to the passage by the side gate and stood there.

units.source_text: 小君觉得要公子在这里久候，太委屈了，

en.t: Kogimi felt it was far too unfair to make the prince wait there for long,

units.source_text: 走来对他说：“今夜来了一个很难得来的人，我不便走近姐姐那里去。”

en.t: so he came over and said to him, "Tonight someone who almost never comes has arrived, so I cannot easily go near my sister's room."

units.source_text: 源氏公子道：“如此说来，今夜又只得空手回去了。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "If that is so, then tonight I must go back empty-handed again.
Is that not too cruel a thing to put someone through?"

units.source_text: 客人回去之后，我立刻想办法。”

en.t: After the visitor leaves, I will think of a way at once."

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“这样看来，他会教这个人顺从我的。

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "Judging from this, he will persuade that person to yield to me.

units.source_text: 小君虽然年纪小，然而见乖识巧，懂得人情世故，

en.t: Although Kogimi is young, he is perceptive and clever, and he understands the ways of the world;

units.source_text: 是个稳健可靠的孩子呢。”

en.t: he is a steady and dependable child."
